text:
rachel: Bringing up Cepheus-11B (Gemma-attn blocks grafted onto Llama-style FF). Converter did weight mapping + int3 calibration. Short tests look ok but long-document QA shows progressive context drift after ~1k tokens.
tony: numbers?
rachel: on our long-doc QA benchmark accuracy falls ~20% vs fp16; rouge-L -14, ppl +55 at 4k context. Short context (<512) almost identical.
jess: sounds like a positional/rope problem. Any converter warnings?
rachel: converter log: 
```
WARN: detected_head_stride=4 (possible interleaved export)
WARN: rope_meta: missing per_block_freqs, using fallback base=8192
INFO: quant: int3 dynamic applied, calibration samples=128
```
petra: head_stride=4 is rare. If exporter interleaves groups, flattening without a canonical permutation will reorder q/k/v per-head. That shows as low per-head cosine.
tony: did you run per-head projections cosine between fp16 and int3 outputs?
rachel: yes. layers 10-13 mean ~0.72 cosine, others >0.97. Also ran kv_cosine vs timestep: layer11 drops t0=0.996 t512=0.667 t1024=0.321.
jess: definite rope/phase mismatch there. Also int3 can amplify small phase errors. Do we have rope metadata in the original artifacts?
rachel: model card had rope_params: {"bases": [8192, 4096], "per_head_offset": true, "phase_offsets": [0, 0.5]} but exporter omitted rope_params during export. Converter defaulted to base=8192 uniform.
petra: phase_offsets[1]=0.5 is notable. That suggests half-frequency for the second group; if we ignored that, residual phase error will accumulate with position.
tony: two-pronged fix: 1) add canonical permutation for head_stride!=1 in converter 2) read rope_params/per-head offsets from model card and emit per-layer metadata.
rachel: quick local experiment: applied head permutation to contiguous layout + manually set second-base=4096 for layers 10-13 and re-quantized int3 with per-channel symmetric calibrator on q/k/v/out. Rouge-L recovered ~11 pts (now -3 vs fp16).
jess: nice. The remaining gap could be int3 granularity on small-magnitude attention projections. Try micro-buckets for calibration or fallback to int4 for those layers.
petra: also check tokenizer stability. Cepheus tokenizer normalizes U+FE0F sequences which sometimes appear in pasted docs; token shifts at high position indices can cause catastrophic drift.
rachel: token diff sample: at token index ~938 we saw a split: fp16 ids vs converted ids differ by +1 for ~120 tokens following, which could amplify rotary misalignment effects.
tony: so compound issue: head interleave + missing per-head rope params + tokenizer split + aggressive int3 quant.
jess: operational steps: A) patch converter to honor rope_params and per-head phase_offsets if present; B) export a permutation map whenever inferred_head_stride!=1 and include checksum artifact; C) add preflight tests: kv_cosine curve up to t=2048 (fail if any layer <0.9 at t=256), token_alignment check (sample long doc and require <0.05% token drift), quant-calibration modes (per-channel, micro-bucketing); D) add canary + automatic rollback policy.
rachel: I'll open PR with converter changes (apply permutation + rope metadata ingestion) and a small int3 per-channel calibrator flag. Will attach permutation table to model tar.
ciabot: rachel pushed branch "cepheus/rope-perhead-int3-calib" (5 commits). CI queued.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to eng-dedicated at 2026-04-10T01:30:00Z routing 7% traffic to model:cepheus-11b:v2-canary. rollback: if long-doc accuracy drop >4% for 20m.
tonY: happy to help run calibration sweep tomorrow and try int4 fallback for layers 10-13.
rachel: thanks. I'll post calibration logs and kv_cosine plots when CI completes.
